paragraphs: We agreed to use both ISA allowances for the new tax year. We recommend making pension contributions into both SIPPs up to the appropriate level. {marker:sipp_contribution_amounts} We recommend adding to the Holloway joint GIA. {marker:gia_addition_amount} We recommend placing the remaining balance into a new jointly-held investment account. {marker:new_account_balance} We agreed to disinvest a portion of the Holloway joint GIA and rebalance it. {marker:gia_portion_sold} We recommend making no other changes at this time. The money available to invest now is {fact:money.available}.
